Manage Compute Cloud resources

Usage:
  yc compute <group|command> [flags...] [args...]

Groups:
  disk                         Manage disks
  instance                     Manage virtual machine instances

Commands:
  operation                    Manage compute operations

Flags:
      --format string
          Output format: text (default), yaml, json, json-rest

Global Flags:
      --profile string
          Set the custom configuration file
      --debug
          Debug logging
